name: Zoltán Kis
bio:
Zoltán's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for racing simulations. This sparked a deep interest in the underlying data that drives performance. He holds a degree in Statistics from Eötvös Loránd University, Budapest, and started his career analysing financial data before transitioning to motorsports. He believes in the power of meticulous data analysis to unlock hidden advantages, and his demanding nature ensures that every piece of information is scrutinized for potential gains. Zoltán joined ROWE Racing two years ago, quickly establishing himself as a key asset in optimizing race strategies and car setups.

His approach to data analysis is characterized by a rigorous, methodical approach. He believes in breaking down complex problems into smaller, manageable components, and his ability to identify subtle trends and patterns has proven invaluable in improving the team's performance. What sets Zoltán apart is his uncanny ability to translate complex data insights into actionable recommendations for the engineers and drivers. He is not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and consistently pushes the team to explore new strategies based on data-driven insights.

physical.description: Zoltán is of average height with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a Rubik's Cube and solves it during breaks.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rapidly when deep in thought.
